greeting.text: Oh! A new customer! ...I mean, a new friend. I am {npc}, but everyone says Lili. I carry things. A lot of things. Do you need something carried?
Hello! Lili, supporter, at your service. Cheap, quick and nearly always honest. Who are you, {player}?
{player}! You look like someone who has loot to carry.
Good to see you. Your pouch is heavier than last time. Mine is lighter. Funny, is it not?
Do not tell Bell I said this, but I am happy you are here.

hint.text: A supporter's rule: always carry more than you need, and never be the one to touch the trap.
Potions, rope, a lantern. Nobody remembers the lantern until it is dark.
A good fight is mostly preparation. A good escape is all preparation.
Monsters call monsters. If you hear a roar, count the exits first.
The upper floors have a Minotaur, which is rude, because I work those floors. Bring it down and the prices go back to normal.
A black Goliath? Welf is already drawing plans for what to do with its hide. Do not ask me what black hide costs.
The Water City has a two-headed thing. Its scales are worth more than I will say out loud. The red head eats magic, so do not stand in its mist and cast.
The White Palace is bone all the way down. I am not carrying any of it. Ask Ais.
Everything is down? Then I will have to find new work. I am joking. I am joking! There is always work.

shop.text: Potions, rope, a lantern, whatever the supporter can carry! Which, as you can see, is a lot.
Everything has a fair price. Fair to me, mostly.

quest_offer.text: Do you want a job? The two-headed dragon in the Water City. Bring it down and I will tell everyone who helped. The scales alone... never mind. Interested?

quest_done.text: You beat it! The Amphisbaena! Oh, the scales... I mean, the whole city thanks you. I mean I do. Thank you, {player}.

farewell.text: Pay your debts and do not fall behind.
